<a id="bad_pelican"></a>
## Galloping Heavy Metal Epic: `bad_pelican.yml`

A galloping heavy metal epic of the mid eighties in the manner of Rime of the Ancient Mariner (Iron
Maiden), with riffs and tunes of its own. A bass and guitars galloping on i VI VII over a plain
beat; a twin-guitar tune in thirds that opens the song and returns; a narrating verse and a broad
chorus; a middle at 80 for a bass alone, a clean guitar remembering the tune and a pad; a build on
tom-toms into a fast instrumental at 168; the chorus and the tune again at the gallop.

<a id="loud_complaint"></a>
## Fast Heavy Metal: `loud_complaint.yml`

A fast, furious British heavy metal song of the early eighties in the manner of Screaming for
Vengeance (Judas Priest), with riffs and tunes of its own. A riff with a flat second and a flat
fifth for two guitars an octave apart over a plain, heavy beat; a verse barked on one note on i VI
VII; a chorus of two shouts and a cry on i VI III VII with the kick on every beat and the band
shouting; a twin-guitar tune, a solo from each guitar and a breakdown.
